channel.title: Clippy
channel.description: Clippy — always-on macOS assistant. Update feed.

item.title: Version 0.2.1
item.description:
• Sign-in window no longer re-opens every minute — stale tokens are now cleared the moment the backend reports them invalid.
  • Polished DMG with night-sky background and paperclip app icon.
  • Carried over: Clips, Composio v3, live auto-update, monochrome approval UI, approval-button hit-test fix.

item.title: Version 0.1.1
item.description:
• Backend reliability: env-newline trimming, Azure audio API pinned, multipart fix, GPT-5 sampling-param sanitisation, GREATEST(0,…) for Postgres.
  • Whisper transcription locked to English (no accent-driven Hindi/Marathi drift).
  • Notch dismiss: race fix, dismiss-suppression window, follow-up Fn-ask clears stale answers.
  • Sign-in error: tap-to-dismiss + 6s auto-dismiss.
  • Keychain service rename + file-first read so adhoc-signed builds stop popping keychain prompts.
  • 3-layer identity guardrails (input pre-filter + system prompt + output filter).
